limitations: Small correlated graph samples with4–8 vertices and shared question wording; no production-scale generalization claim.
No human preference labels or business-value evaluation.
No comparison to a jointly trained single adapter, so two-adapter superiority over that alternative is unproven.
Planning and fixed-context interpretation improved; reserved full workflows did not improve.
Complex chart generation and semantic repair remain unreliable.
Shared-resource evaluation timings do not establish an isolated latency benchmark.
